g0.rationale: Modes: 'Als Haarmaske' — wet hair, 3 min, rinse → qualifies (wet-hair rinse-out use read as post-cleansing). Leave-in and overnight modes are not rinsed. Exactly one qualifying mode → mode-scoped.

tailMarker.note: Earliest tail-class species PARFUM @9 (Sodium Benzoate @14). Base species (Cetearyl @2, Distearoylethyl Hydroxyethylmonium Methosulfate @4, Sunflower Hybrid Oil @8) outrank it; Behentrimonium Chloride @11 and Cetrimonium Chloride @12 are secondary co-quats in the tail. Plausible (see review note). tail_index−1 = Helianthus Annuus Hybrid Oil @8.

conditioningLevel.rationale: S1: only Distearoylethyl Hydroxyethylmonium Methosulfate @4 above tail → fails. S2: Cetearyl Alcohol @2. S3: Helianthus Annuus Hybrid Oil @8 only (Isoamyl Laurate @10 in tail) → fails. One signal → moderate.

weightPotential.rationale: Low is withheld by conjunct 3: three cationic species on the full list (@4, @11, @12; E7). High would need Helianthus Annuus Hybrid Oil @8 to be an R4b heavy triglyceride; it is a conventional plant oil whose R4a/R4b band is not explicit in the standard and it sits at tail_index−1, so it is not treated as establishing a high core (an ambiguous band may not fail toward an extreme, §9.1 fallback/§1.1). → moderate either way.
counterSignals: Sunflower Hybrid Oil @8 band ambiguity at tail_index−1

careDirection.rationale: No R5 species. Humectant cluster above tail: Glycerin @3, Panthenol @5, Aloe Juice Powder @6, Sodium Hyaluronate @7 → coherent humectant/conditioning base → moisture. Plausible marker, unambiguous separation.

repairSupportLevel.rationale: No R5 route and no bond token → ordinary conditioning.

primaryFocus.rationale: Step 3 clears nothing. D5 guard: criterion 1 — 4 distinct humectants above tail (Glycerin @3, Panthenol @5, Aloe @6 counted once, Sodium Hyaluronate @7), 3 non-glycerin; criterion 2 — not lipid-led (at most one plant oil, @8, ranked below the whole cluster); criterion 3 — no richer route. Confidence high: ≥3 humectants with Glycerin @3 and Panthenol @5 in the first five ranks, plausible marker, no competing route. focus_care_verdict: moisture_supported; claim_role: corroborating ('Aqua Hyaluron').

secondaryFocus.rationale: No second distinct endpoint (no silicone/polymer, no protein).

fired.note: Profile describes only the 3-min rinse-out Haarmaske mode.
